document_title: Configure email notifications for a custom event
content:
Configure a post function to fire the custom event in your workflows
Post functions allow you to automate some actions when people transition work items down their workflow. In this case, we want to use a post function to tell Jira when you want your custom email event to fire, or what transition should trigger the email event.
- Select Settings (), then Work items.
- In the sidebar, under WORKFLOWS, click Workflows.
- Find the workflow that you want to add your event to and select Edit.
- While viewing the workflow's diagram, select the transition that should fire the custom email event.
- While viewing the transition's details, under Options, select Post functions.
- In the table showing the transition's post functions, locate the Fire a… post function. Select the pencil icon to edit the post function.
- In the Event dropdrown menu, select the custom event you want to fire in this transition.
- Select Update.
- Publish the changes to your workflow by selecting Publish draft.
You did it! Now, any space that uses this workflow will get your custom email event notification on the transition you elected.
Was this helpful?
